shots.subject: A small snowy wizard village at twilight: crooked old stone and timber cottages with steep snowy gabled roofs, smoking chimneys, glowing bow-windowed shops including a sweet shop full of colorful jars, wreaths and garlands, a cobbled lane covered in snow; two students in long black robes stand in front of the sweet shop window with their backs to the camera, one in a green-and-silver striped scarf, one in a yellow-and-black striped scarf
shots.composition: Eye-level view from across the snowy lane; the sweet shop window glows at the center, the two students stand small in front of it in the lower middle, filling about a quarter of the frame height, the lane curves away on the left
shots.motion_elements: the falling snow, the chimney smoke and the warm glow in the shop windows

shots.subject: The high street of a small snowy wizard village on a quiet grey afternoon: crooked stone and timber cottages and shops with thick snowy thatched and slate roofs, bow windows glowing warm with sweets, books and cauldrons, smoke rising from tall chimneys, wreaths on the doors, garlands along the shopfronts, the snowy lane running between them toward distant white hills
shots.composition: Wide eye-level view from the middle of the snowy lane looking down the high street, the buildings stepping away on both sides
shots.motion_elements: the falling snow, the chimney smoke and the warm shop window glow

shots.subject: An old village pub at night in a snowy wizard village: a crooked timber-framed front with small leaded windows misted with steam and glowing gold from the fire inside, a plain hanging wooden sign with no lettering, a wreath on the heavy door, garlands along the eaves; two students in long black robes stand still by the steamy window, one with a blonde ponytail and a blue-and-bronze scarf, one in a knitted wool hat and a scarlet-and-gold scarf
shots.composition: Wide eye-level view from further back, across the snowy lane; the pub front fills the frame and the two students stand small beside the window, backs to the camera
shots.motion_elements: the steam on the windows, the chimney smoke and the flickering firelight behind the glass

shots.subject: Inside a cozy old village pub in a wizard village at night: low black oak beams hung with dried hops and evergreen garlands, a huge stone inglenook fireplace with a roaring log fire, worn wooden tables with tankards of steaming mulled cider, small leaded windows steamed up, candles in bottles, a decorated Christmas tree by the bar
shots.composition: Wide view from near the door across the room toward the fireplace, the flagstone floor open in front

shots.subject: A small crooked wizard village sweet shop seen from across a snowy lane on a grey snowy afternoon: the whole shop front with its glowing bow window full of glass jars of colorful sweets, trays of fudge and striped candy canes, a small candle-lit tree inside, snow on the sill, a striped awning and a snow-covered roof; one student in a long black robe and a green-and-silver striped scarf, short straight brown hair, stands still at the window looking in

shots.motion_elements: the candle flames on the little tree, the warm window glow and the steam of breath in the cold air

shots.subject: The snowy square of a small wizard village at blue hour: a huge Christmas fir tree in the middle hung with gold and red baubles and hundreds of warm candle-like lights, a ring of crooked stone and timber shops and cottages around it with glowing windows, garlands on every front, smoke from the chimneys, deep snow on the ground

shots.subject: A tiny country railway station at the edge of a snowy wizard village on a grey afternoon: a stone station house with a snow-covered roof and a glowing window, a wooden roofed shelter with an iron bench, old iron lamps, a wreath on the station door, snowy empty tracks curving away into white fields and fir trees, no signs or lettering

shots.subject: A tiny country railway station of a wizard village at night under falling snow: the stone station house with a glowing window and smoking chimney, old iron lamps along the snowy walkway, a garland on the shelter; one student in a long black robe and a yellow-and-black striped scarf, a dark braid, stands still with a small trunk at the edge of the walkway looking down the empty tracks
